items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: I played with him at the old club called the Avalon Club in the old days.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's right. I thought I was getting kind of a little confused for a minute. Of course, naturally, I didn't get to hear those fellows as much as I did with the other

fellows. I didn't get around those fellows as much as I did with those fellows. I thought you, Louis Primo was really good in his early days. I think he played much better than he does now. I played with him at the old club called the Avalon Club in the old days. He was playing quite, playing real good trumpet at that time. He was a real good copy of Louis Armstrong in those days.
